themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can independently conduct research, analyze data, and make decisions within a research context.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI tools designed to assist with various aspects of the research process.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as research papers, meeting notes, or transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications for analyzing datasets to extract insights, identify patterns, and support decision-making.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that review, compare, and assess the effectiveness of various AI tools for specific tasks or industries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of artificial user representations for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI affects jobs, hiring, reskilling, and the overall nature of work.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use, capabilities, limitations, and user interactions with AI-powered chatbots.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications that directly assist or augment the design and user research processes, including ideation and prototyping.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
